basic_info.description: Bright and spacious top-floor, three-bedroom, two bath residence with parking in a prime location close to Japantown, Hayes Valley, Fillmore, and the Civic Center performing arts. Featuring a large open-concept living and dining room with green-scape and tree-top outlooks. Generous floor-to-ceiling glass doors open to a private balcony with space for lounging and outdoor dining. Custom shutters provide privacy and filtered light. Spacious kitchen flows nicely into living/dining area and offers large granite countertops, full-height cabinetry and new lighting. Long hallway separating entertainment and private spaces provides three hallway closets including one large walk-in. Large bedrooms with spacious closets and bright sky outlooks.  Two updated contemporary bathrooms with large soaking tubs and new lighting. Abundant closet space throughout. Monthly dues include All utilities, yes all, and parking-owners only pay for wifi/internet. Prime location close to fabulous Japantown, Hayes Valley and Fillmore district restaurants, nightlife and shopping. Located in the historic and architecturally significant St. Francis Square Cooperative with its rich history it also provides lovely landscaped courtyards, recreation facilities, and other amenities for residents to enjoy.
